senses.gloss: m. (preced.) earth-ward, that which, he who, is below, nethermost.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 16:3">Targ. Josh. XVI, 3</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:4:6">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>שלח א׳</he> to put off the undergarment.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 10:1:4">Y. B. Mets. X, beg. 12ᶜ</cite> <cite ref="A03224"><he>ארעייא</he></cite> who lives in the story below.—Pl. <he>אַרְעָאִין</he>, <he>אַרְעָאֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 6:16">Targ. Gen. VI, 16</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>עביד בא׳ וכ׳</he> deal with the inferiors (females) as thou didst with the superiors (men); <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:19">ib. to IV, 19</cite>; Y. Succ. V, 55ᵇ (incorr. vers.).—Fem. <cite ref="A03226"><he>אַרְעִיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 41:7">Targ. Ez. XLI, 7</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Maas. Sh. V, 56ᶜ top.—Pl. <cite ref="A03226"><he>אַרְעַיָּתָא</he></cite>, <he>אַרְעַיָּיתָא</he>.
